decisions.reason: The existing event correctly removes Big Block references from the About-page copy, but the source does not change prize collection from one-click claiming to automatic wallet transfer.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hey Joseph, id like to eliminate the big blocks and give that extra $1 to me, so it'll be:
$15 buy, $5 to me,  $5 to affiliate,  $5 to block prize pool.

Increases my bottom line with minimal impact on sales.
Plus it simplifies the game mechanics and marketing.

Giveing myself and each community member an even split, as well as everyone getting an even shot at the never ending $500 prizes seems aligned with the projects ethos.

how_it_works_copy.mint: Purchase the ebook NFT for $15 USD; the mint number is the referral code.
how_it_works_copy.referrals: Sharing the mint number or link earns an instant $5 USD for each referred mint, with no limit or expiration; when no code is used, the commission and Small Block ticket go to a random existing ticket holder.
how_it_works_copy.tickets: Each referral gives a Small Block prize ticket for the current block, and more referrals provide more chances to win.
how_it_works_copy.prizes: Small Block awards continuing $500 prizes, counting mint and secondary sales, with winners selected through Chainlink VRF; do not describe a Big Block prize.
how_it_works_copy.reward_collection: Commissions are sent automatically on-chain, while prize wins are announced on the Winners page and claimed with one click.

decisions.reason: The existing same-message MODIFY already removes Big Block descriptions and updates the FAQ's Small Block tickets, prize funding, and primary-mint allocation copy.
The existing same-message MODIFY fully records the $5 founder allocation, $5 referral commission, $5 Small Block pool allocation, and removal of Big Block as a pool destination.
The existing same-message MODIFY already replaces the two-tier prize-pool marketing copy with continuing Small Block $500 prizes and no Big Block advertisement.
The existing same-message MODIFY reduces issuance and counters to Small Block and removes the obsolete Big Block eligibility-window and post-draw-action attributes.
The existing same-message MODIFY records the necessary $5 primary-mint contribution to the surviving Small Block prize pool; the established $500 prize mechanics otherwise remain unchanged.
The existing same-message MODIFY removes the obsolete Big Block ticket-counter metadata key while preserving the Small Block counter and permanent badges.
The existing same-message MODIFY limits eligibility and scope to Small Block while preserving the unchanged Chainlink VRF selection method.
The existing same-message MODIFY removes Big Block from secondary-royalty prize-pool destinations; the source does not change the secondary-sale royalty amount or founder share.
Eliminating Big Block prizes does not change the surviving prize collection method or winner-wallet payout destination.
The Big Block removal and primary-mint allocation change do not alter referral-milestone badges, their icons, storage, or current effect.
Transactional email delivery and generic prize-winner notifications remain valid for Small Block prizes and contain no current Big Block-specific attribute requiring removal.
